episodes.title: 1. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Arman reluctantly embarks on a submarine research trip sponsored by his father. At the Incirlik Air Base, Hatice reports an unusual radiometer reading.

episodes.title: 2. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Amid a search for survivors in Kos, Arman and Defne rush to find Kenan before sunrise. Felix and Cem scramble to restore electric power to the town.

episodes.title: 3. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Inside the submarine, tensions come to a head between Arman and Umut. When Barış's actions unravel, Erenay confronts an impossible dilemma.

episodes.title: 4. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Arman and Yonca must swim out to fix a rupture, but the submarine is still in jeopardy. The Yakamoz crew discovers an intruder.

episodes.title: 5. Bölüm
episodes.summary: After Hatice reveals a shocking truth about Erenay, Umut and Yonca begin to suspect Defne. The crew tracks an airplane. Cem makes a devastating choice.

episodes.title: 6. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Umut decides to switch course and head for a seed vault in Norway. Hatice snoops inside Defne's room. The crew docks in Spain, and carnage ensues.

episodes.title: 7. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Umut reads a message from NATO that leads him to lash out against Arman. Arman sets a trap for Umut and speaks to his father on the phone.
